about.label: About Me
about.heading: The Creative Mind Behind the Code
about.body: I'm a AI-Driven Engineer and Product Designer based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. I combine design and development in a single profile, which means I can take a product from concept to polished interface without losing coherence along the way. I care deeply about the details: the right spacing, the right interaction, the right words. That's how I build digital products that feel as good as they work.

projects.caption: The {count} most recent
phrases: Every project starts with a question, not a screen.
Research shapes the flows, the flows shape the system.
Design and code stay in the same hands, so nothing gets lost in handoff.
Each project is a story, from brief to launch, design to code.

ristario.title: Website Design & Development
ristario.summary: Complete design and development of Ristario website. From concept to production, including UX/UI design, branding, and full-stack implementation.

move-the-chain.title: SaaS Platform
move-the-chain.summary: Design and development of a SaaS platform focused on employee engagement: workflows, wireframes, prototypes and the design system, then built into features, integrations and reusable components.

fundacion-pataro.title: Foundation Website Design
fundacion-pataro.summary: Complete UX/UI design for Fundación Pataro website. Focused on accessibility, user experience and visual identity to communicate the foundation's mission effectively.

iacon.title: Landing Page Redesigning
iacon.summary: Redesign of IACON's corporate landing page in Figma, along with new visual assets and branding elements to strengthen the company's digital identity.

smart-factory.title: Web Dashboard
smart-factory.summary: Design of an industrial dashboard used by factory operators to monitor and control production machinery. Project created from scratch with data-first UI.

cc-webapp.title: Web Application
cc-webapp.summary: Task management web application for call centers. Users can schedule, manage and track client calls. Flows, wireframes and visual prototype.

psy-app.title: Mobile App
psy-app.summary: Integrative UX/UI project for an iOS app designed for psychologists. Developed from scratch with the full Design Thinking process, research and testing.
